mailHints.SMTP_INCOMPLETE: Variables alone are not enough: use real SMTP credentials from a provider. Guide: backend-separado/docs/BREVO_SMTP.md
mailHints.NO_FRONTEND_URL: SMTP is complete. Add FRONTEND_URL in Render (your app’s public URL, no trailing slash) so reset links in emails are correct.
mailHints.NO_MAIL_FROM: SMTP and URL are set. Add MAIL_FROM in Render with the sender email you verified in Brevo (Senders). Without it, Brevo often rejects mail because SMTP_USER is not a valid From address.
